newsitem.title: USA: Xerox increases prices on selected printers.
newsitem.headline: Xerox increases prices on selected printers.

text.p: Xerox Corp said it is increasing sales prices on selected high-speed printing systems products in the U.S.

Price increases on selected 50 page per minute and faster printers will range from three to seven percent. This group includes the 4050, 4850, 4090, 4890, 4135 and 9700 product families, Xerox said. Sales prices on selected software solutions will increase by five percent.
The price hikes are effective January 1 for sales to commercial customers. Increases for contract and governmental customers will be effective at their next contract renewal.
